If timeout is reached - request will return with service error.</p></div></div><!--/$--></div></div><div id="request" class="relative space-y-3 fern-endpoint-section-request-body"><div class="inline-flex max-w-full min-w-0 flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-1" data-state="closed"><h3 class="mt-0">Request</h3></div><!--$--><div class="fern-prose prose max-w-none break-words text-sm text-(color:--grayscale-a11)">Parameters of a new collection<!-- --></div><!--/$--><div data-orientation="horizontal" role="none" class="bg-border-default shrink-0 h-px w-full"></div><div id="request.body.vectors" class="relative m-3 space-y-3 mx-0"><div class="inline-flex max-w-full min-w-0 flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-1" data-state="closed"><span class="fern-api-property-key">vectors</span><span class="fern-api-property-meta"><span class="fern-api-property-type">object or map from strings to objects</span><span class="fern-api-property-optional">Optional</span></span></div><div class="fern-prose prose max-w-none break-words text-sm fern-api-property-description text-(color:--grayscale-a11)"><div style="display:contents"><p>Vector params separator for single and multiple vector modes Single mode:</p>
<p>{ “size”: 128, “distance”: “Cosine” }</p>
<p>or multiple mode:</p>
<p>{ “default”: { “size”: 128, “distance”: “Cosine” } }</p></div></div><!--$!--><template data-dgst="BAILOUT_TO_CLIENT_SIDE_RENDERING"></template><!--/$--></div><div data-orientation="horizontal" role="none" class="shrink-0 h-px w-full bg-border-default"></div><div id="request.body.shard_number" class="relative m-3 space-y-3 mx-0"><div class="inline-flex max-w-full min-w-0 flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-1" data-state="closed"><span class="fern-api-property-key">shard_number</span><span class="fern-api-property-meta"><span class="fern-api-property-type">uint or null</span><span class="fern-api-property-optional">Optional</span></span></div><div class="fern-prose prose max-w-none break-words text-sm fern-api-property-description text-(color:--grayscale-a11)"><div style="display:contents"><p>For auto sharding: Number of shards in collection. - Default is 1 for standalone, otherwise equal to the number of nodes - Minimum is 1</p>
<p>For custom sharding: Number of shards in collection per shard group. - Default is 1, meaning that each shard key will be mapped to a single shard - Minimum is 1</p></div></div></div><div data-orientation="horizontal" role="none" class="shrink-0 h-px w-full bg-border-default"></div><div id="request.body.sharding_method" class="relative m-3 space-y-3 mx-0"><div class="inline-flex max-w-full min-w-0 flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-1" data-state="closed"><span class="fern-api-property-key">sharding_method</span><span class="fern-api-property-meta"><span class="fern-api-property-type">enum or any</span><span class="fern-api-property-optional">Optional</span></span></div><div class="fern-prose prose max-w-none break-words text-sm fern-api-property-description text-(color:--grayscale-a11)"><div style="display:contents"><p>Sharding method Default is Auto - points are distributed across all available shards Custom - points are distributed across shards according to shard key</p></div></div><!--$!--><template data-dgst="BAILOUT_TO_CLIENT_SIDE_RENDERING"></template><!--/$--></div><div data-orientation="horizontal" role="none" class="shrink-0 h-px w-full bg-border-default"></div><div id="request.body.replication_factor" class="relative m-3 space-y-3 mx-0"><div class="inline-flex max-w-full min-w-0 flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-1" data-state="closed"><span class="fern-api-property-key">replication_factor</span><span class="fern-api-property-meta"><span class="fern-api-property-type">uint or null</span><span class="fern-api-property-optional">Optional</span></span></div><div class="fern-prose prose max-w-none break-words text-sm fern-api-property-description text-(color:--grayscale-a11)">Number of shards replicas. Default is 1 Minimum is 1</div></div><div data-orientation="horizontal" role="none" class="shrink-0 h-px w-full bg-border-default"></div><div id="request.body.write_consistency_factor" class="relative m-3 space-y-3 mx-0"><div class="inline-flex max-w-full min-w-0 flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-1" data-state="closed"><span class="fern-api-property-key">write_consistency_factor</span><span class="fern-api-property-meta"><span class="fern-api-property-type">uint or null</span><span class="fern-api-property-optional">Optional</span></span></div><div class="fern-prose prose max-w-none break-words text-sm fern-api-property-description text-(color:--grayscale-a11)">Defines how many replicas should apply the operation for us to consider it successful. Increasing this number will make the collection more resilient to inconsistencies, but will also make it fail if not enough replicas are available. Does not have any performance impact.</div></div><div data-orientation="horizontal" role="none" class="shrink-0 h-px w-full bg-border-default"></div><div id="request.body.on_disk_payload" class="relative m-3 space-y-3 mx-0"><div class="inline-flex max-w-full min-w-0 flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-1" data-state="closed"><span class="fern-api-property-key">on_disk_payload</span><span class="fern-api-property-meta"><span class="fern-api-property-type">boolean or null</span><span class="fern-api-property-optional">Optional</span></span></div><div class="fern-prose prose max-w-none break-words text-sm fern-api-property-description text-(color:--grayscale-a11)"><div style="display:contents"><p>If true - point’s payload will not be stored in memory. It will be read from the disk every time it is requested. This setting saves RAM by (slightly) increasing the response time. Note: those payload values that are involved in filtering and are indexed - remain in RAM.</p>
<p>Default: true</p></div></div></div><div data-orientation="horizontal" role="none" class="shrink-0 h-px w-full bg-border-default"></div><div id="request.body.hnsw_config" class="relative m-3 space-y-3 mx-0"><div class="inline-flex max-w-full min-w-0 flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-1" data-state="closed"><span class="fern-api-property-key">hnsw_config</span><span class="fern-api-property-meta"><span class="fern-api-property-type">object or any</span><span class="fern-api-property-optional">Optional</span></span></div><div class="fern-prose prose max-w-none break-words text-sm fern-api-property-description text-(color:--grayscale-a11)"><div style="display:contents"><p>Custom params for HNSW index. If none - values from service configuration file are used.</p></div></div><!--$!--><template data-dgst="BAILOUT_TO_CLIENT_SIDE_RENDERING"></template><!--/$--></div><div data-orientation="horizontal" role="none" class="shrink-0 h-px w-full bg-border-default"></div><div id="request.body.wal_config" class="relative m-3 space-y-3 mx-0"><div class="inline-flex max-w-full min-w-0 flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-1" data-state="closed"><span class="fern-api-property-key">wal_config</span><span class="fern-api-property-meta"><span class="fern-api-property-type">object or any</span><span class="fern-api-property-optional">Optional</span></span></div><div class="fern-prose prose max-w-none break-words text-sm fern-api-property-description text-(color:--grayscale-a11)"><div style="display:contents"><p>Custom params for WAL. application/json\n\nCreates a new collection with the given parameters.\n\nReference: https://api.qdrant.tech/v-1-18-x/api-reference/collections/create-collection\n\n## Authentication\n\n- `api-key` header (required)\n\n## Servers\n\n- `http://localhost:6333` (http, default)\n- `https://localhost:6333` (https)\n\n## Request\n\n### Path parameters\n\n- `collection_name` (string, required) — Name of the new collection\n\n### Query parameters\n\n- `timeout` (integer, optional) — Wait for operation commit timeout in seconds. If timeout is reached - request will return with service error.\n\n### Body (application/json)\n\n- `vectors` (object or map from string to object, optional) — Vector params separator for single and multiple vector modes Single mode: \\{ \"size\": 128, \"distance\": \"Cosine\" } or multiple mode: \\{ \"default\": \\{ \"size\": 128, \"distance\": \"Cosine\" } }\n  - VectorParams\n    - `size` (uint64, required) — Size of a vectors used\n    - `distance` (enum, required) — Type of internal tags, build from payload Distance function types used to compare vectors\n      - Allowed values: `Cosine`, `Euclid`, `Dot`, `Manhattan`\n    - `hnsw_config` (object or any, optional) — Custom params for HNSW index. If none - values from collection configuration are used.\n      - HnswConfigDiff\n        - `m` (integer, optional, nullable) — Number of edges per node in the index graph. Larger the value - more accurate the search, more space required.\n        - `ef_construct` (integer, optional, nullable) — Number of neighbours to consider during the index building. Larger the value - more accurate the search, more time required to build the index.\n        - `full_scan_threshold` (integer, optional, nullable) — Minimal size threshold (in KiloBytes) below which full-scan is preferred over HNSW search. This measures the total size of vectors being queried against. When the maximum estimated amount of points that a condition satisfies is smaller than `full_scan_threshold_kb`, the query planner will use full-scan search instead of HNSW index traversal for better performance. Note: 1Kb = 1 vector of size 256\n        - `max_indexing_threads` (integer, optional, nullable) — Number of parallel threads used for background index building. If 0 - automatically select from 8 to 16. Best to keep between 8 and 16 to prevent likelihood of building broken/inefficient HNSW graphs. On small CPUs, less threads are used.\n        - `on_disk` (boolean, optional, nullable) — Store HNSW index on disk. If set to false, the index will be stored in RAM. Default: false\n        - `payload_m` (integer, optional, nullable) — Custom M param for additional payload-aware HNSW links. If not set, default M will be used.\n        - `inline_storage` (boolean, optional, nullable) — Store copies of original and quantized vectors within the HNSW index file. Default: false. Enabling this option will trade the search speed for disk usage by reducing amount of random seeks during the search. Requires quantized vectors to be enabled. Multi-vectors are not supported.\n    - `quantization_config` (object or object or object or object or any, optional) — Custom params for quantization. If none - values from collection configuration are used.\n    - `on_disk` (boolean, optional, nullable) — If true, vectors are served from disk, improving RAM usage at the cost of latency Default: false\n    - `datatype` (enum or any, optional) — Defines which datatype should be used to represent vectors in the storage. Choosing different datatypes allows to optimize memory usage and performance vs accuracy. - For `float32` datatype - vectors are stored as single-precision floating point numbers, 4 bytes. - For `float16` datatype - vectors are stored as half-precision floating point numbers, 2 bytes. - For `uint8` datatype - vectors are stored as unsigned 8-bit integers, 1 byte. It expects vector elements to be in range `[0, 255]`.\n    - `multivector_config` (object or any, optional)\n      - MultiVectorConfig\n        - `comparator` (enum, required)\n          - Allowed values: `max_sim`\n- `shard_number` (uint, optional, nullable) — For auto sharding: Number of shards in collection. - Default is 1 for standalone, otherwise equal to the number of nodes - Minimum is 1 For custom sharding: Number of shards in collection per shard group. - Default is 1, meaning that each shard key will be mapped to a single shard - Minimum is 1\n- `sharding_method` (enum or any, optional) — Sharding method Default is Auto - points are distributed across all available shards Custom - points are distributed across shards according to shard key\n- `replication_factor` (uint, optional, nullable) — Number of shards replicas. Default is 1 Minimum is 1\n- `write_consistency_factor` (uint, optional, nullable) — Defines how many replicas should apply the operation for us to consider it successful. Increasing this number will make the collection more resilient to inconsistencies, but will also make it fail if not enough replicas are available. Does not have any performance impact.\n- `on_disk_payload` (boolean, optional, nullable) — If true - point's payload will not be stored in memory.
